summary: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V filed an 8-K reporting a mutual extension of the outside date in its merger agreement with Teamshares Inc. from May 31, 2026 to July 15, 2026, to allow more time to close the business combination. No new financial terms or premium were disclosed. The SPAC continues to solicit shareholder approval via an S-4 registration statement. The extension is a procedural step, not a termination or new deal. Watch for shareholder vote and regulatory approval; risk-arb spread may widen if closing delays persist.
